tagline.en: UK MNO (now merged with Vodafone UK) — CS-only £7/£8 budget monthly plans
tagline.zh: 英国实体运营商（已与沃达丰英国合并）——7/8镑便宜月付需找客服开通

description.en: Three is a UK mobile network operator with its own 4G/5G infrastructure (99% population 4G coverage claim), merged with Vodafone UK. Public eSIM pricing starts at £10/40GB a month (per the April 2026 PAYG price guide; the storefront currently promotes 120GB for £13.50); the cheaper £7 (unlimited calls/texts + 3GB) and £8 (unlimited calls/texts + 8GB) monthly plans exist only via customer service. Any usage within 180 days keeps a PAYG number alive.
description.zh: Three是拥有自有4G/5G网络设施的英国实体运营商（宣称4G覆盖99%人口），已与Vodafone英国完成合并。公开渠道最划算的eSIM套餐为10英镑/月40GB（2026年4月PAYG价目表；官网现推13.5英镑120GB档）；更便宜的7英镑（无限通话短信+3GB）与8英镑（无限通话短信+8GB）月付仅客服渠道可办。Paygo号码每180天内有一次任意金额消费即可保号。

details.en:
Three matters here as one of the four UK MNOs: its merger with Vodafone UK is completed, reshaping the UK market, and its network hosts iD Mobile as MVNO. For eSIM buyers the quirk is channel-based pricing: the storefront's best PAYG deal is £10/month for 40GB per the April 2026 price guide (it currently promotes 120GB for £13.50), while CS-only monthly plans at £7 (unlimited calls/texts, 3GB) and £8 (unlimited calls/texts, 8GB) are not published on any official page and could not be publicly corroborated in Sept 2026 — treat them as anecdotal and confirm with customer service before relying on them. Account login needs a Three UK number besides email/password.

Keep-alive for PAYG numbers: one charged event of any amount (an SMS or a call both count) per 180 days. Best suited to users physically in the UK/EU wanting big data on a top-tier network; the source review flags Three for heavy UK/EU data users rather than China-roaming cloud residents, and notes remote-area coverage as its weak spot.
details.zh:
Three 的价值在于它是英国四大实体运营商（MNO）之一：与 Vodafone 英国的合并已完成，英国市场格局因此重塑，iD Mobile 等虚商就挂在其网络上——网络规格本身是一线水平。

对 eSIM 买家而言它的特别之处是渠道定价：官网最划算的 Paygo 按 2026 年 4 月价目表是 10 英镑/月含 40GB（现推 13.5 英镑 120GB 档），而 7 英镑（无限通话短信+3GB）与 8 英镑（无限通话短信+8GB）的月付套餐官网任何页面均未挂出，2026 年 9 月复核也未找到公开佐证——请当作坊间传闻，依赖前先与客服确认。另外账户登录除邮箱密码外还需要一个 Three UK 号码，纯新用户首次开通要走套餐页流程。

Paygo 保号：每 180 天内一次任意金额的计费事件（发条短信或打个电话都算）即可续期，保号成本是短信级。

适合谁：人在英国/欧盟、想要一线网络大流量的用户；源盘点认为 Three 适合英国与欧盟大流量需求者，而非中国漫游云居民，并指出偏远地区覆盖是其弱项——回国场景请看 giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink。

bestFor.en: Heavy UK/EU data users who don't mind contacting CS to unlock the cheaper monthly plans.
bestFor.zh: 英国/欧盟本地大流量用户，不介意找客服解锁更便宜的月付套餐。

en: UK MNO with own 4G/5G network (99% pop 4G claim)
PAYG keep-alive: one charged event per 180 days
zh: 英国实体运营商，自有4G/5G网络（宣称4G覆盖99%人口）
客服专享低价月付：7英镑/3GB、8英镑/8GB
Paygo保号：每180天一次任意计费

plansNote.en: CS-only £7/3GB and £8/8GB plans are not published on any official page and could not be publicly corroborated in the 2026-09 re-check — treat as anecdotal. Storefront PAYG per the 19 Apr 2026 price guide: £10/40GB, £15/100GB, £20/200GB (storefront promo: 120GB for £13.50).
plansNote.zh: 客服专享的7镑/3GB与8镑/8GB套餐官网任何页面均未挂出，2026-09复核亦无公开佐证——请当作坊间传闻。官网Paygo按2026-04-19价目表：£10/40GB、£15/100GB、£20/200GB（官网促销：13.5英镑120GB）。

en: Own-network MNO quality, no MVNO priority penalty
£7–£8 CS monthly plans (anecdotal, no public corroboration) undercut the storefront
Relaxed PAYG keep-alive (any charged event / 180 days)
zh: 自有网络MNO质量，无虚商优先级惩罚
7-8英镑客服月付低于官网价（坊间口径，无公开佐证）
Paygo保号宽松（180天内任意计费即可）

en: Cheapest plans hidden behind CS chat
Login requires an existing Three UK number
Weaker remote-area coverage; not China-roaming oriented
zh: 最便宜套餐藏在客服对话里
账户登录需要已有Three UK号码
偏远地区覆盖较弱；非中国漫游导向
